paragraphs: Rabbi Oshaya, son of Rabbi Yehudah the perfumer—that is, a seller of perfumes. He testified before Rabbi Akiva in Rabbi Tarfon’s name, Chullin 55b. “Yehudah ben Yeshayah the perfumer testified before Rabbi Akiva in Rabbi Tarfon’s name,” Tosefta, Shevi'it, chapter 5; likewise Chullin there, chapter 3.
